item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello, and welcome! Let's find out what the weather is like on this Wednesday, October 14. Wednesday. We are halfway through the week! Shanghai is going to be grey from start to finish today. The warmest part of the day will be 24 degrees, and the coolest 18. It should feel gently warm all day. Rain is very unlikely today. There are 4 days to go until a special day. Can you guess which one? A comfortable day for a walk, not too hot and not too cold. And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be under a blanket of cloud, with a high of 26 degrees. Have you thought any more about jumpers and socks? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
